content.short: A collection of 7777 Cadre Cats Building an Empire on the Cardano Blockchain.
content.description: The Cadre Cats are a collection of 7777 Cats being minted through CardaHub Smart Contract Marketplace for 50 Ada per Cat from their vending machine and website. Mint will go live on the 20th of this month at 7:00 PM UTC. We have back end dev support coming from cyber pickle, for continued project development after our initial sellout, with a continued partnership with Cardahub for all smart contract needs. Our mission is to create metaverse styled assets within the lore of Cadre Cats, available for holders only.
content.meta: Find out about Cadre Cats (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
